COMPACT.heading: Executive Summary
COMPACT.purpose: The problem, intervention, results, duration, geography, applicant and request, all matching the body.

COMPACT.heading: Problem and Need
COMPACT.purpose: Evidence of the problem, its root causes and consequences, for the affected population and place.

COMPACT.heading: Target Population
COMPACT.purpose: Who the project serves and involves, where, and why them.

COMPACT.heading: Goal and Objectives
COMPACT.purpose: The goal (higher-level change) and specific objectives answering the problem, from the Results Model.

COMPACT.heading: Technical Approach
COMPACT.purpose: The core design and why it is expected to work, with evidence of effectiveness.

COMPACT.heading: Implementation
COMPACT.purpose: How and when the activities are delivered, by whom (the workplan table follows from the Results Model).

COMPACT.heading: Expected Results
COMPACT.purpose: The outputs and outcomes, with their indicators and targets from the Results Model.

COMPACT.heading: Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning
COMPACT.purpose: How results are measured and used: indicators, baselines, data sources, frequency, responsibility, quality assurance, learning and evaluation.

COMPACT.heading: Risks and Mitigation
COMPACT.purpose: The material risks, each with a concrete mitigation and an owner.

COMPACT.heading: Sustainability
COMPACT.purpose: How benefits and ownership continue after funding, and scale where it is an aim.

COMPACT.heading: Organisational Capacity and Management
COMPACT.purpose: Specific capability: past projects, dates, donors, scale, results, systems and staff, and the management structure.

COMPACT.heading: Budget Narrative
COMPACT.purpose: What the budget buys and why it is good value, using the budget's own totals.

sections.heading: Project Summary

questions.label: What problem or opportunity will the work address, for whom and where?
questions.help: Your own description is enough; PaperAid finds the evidence.

questions.label: What do you propose to do about it?
Who is the target group?
questions.fallback: PaperAid describes the target group from your description and marks it for you to confirm.

questions.label: Where will the work take place?
questions.fallback: PaperAid uses the place in your description, or keeps the geography general.

questions.label: How many months will the work last?
questions.fallback: PaperAid plans for 12 months and says so.

questions.label: Which currency is the budget in?
questions.fallback: The call's currency, otherwise US dollars.

questions.label: Your organisation: what it is, and the specific projects, years, results or scale that show it can deliver this work
questions.fallback: Without these facts the capacity section stays general and is marked for you to complete.

questions.label: Partners, if any, and what each will do
Which funder or call is this for?
questions.fallback: PaperAid writes for a general funder.

questions.label: Will the work involve children or vulnerable adults?
Will the work collect personal, health or identifiable data?
Your organisation's legal name and registration (for eligibility)
questions.fallback: Not stated; eligibility that depends on it stays for you to confirm.

rules.requirement: If a funding call/template is supplied, extract and resolve mandatory requirements before drafting.
rules.ui_message: The call's requirements were read before drafting

rules.requirement: Explicit eligibility criteria must be evaluated before submission-ready drafting.
rules.ui_message: Eligibility was checked before drafting

rules.requirement: Failed mandatory eligibility prevents READY status.
rules.ui_message: You meet the call's eligibility criteria

rules.requirement: When no external length exists, Standard mode targets 5,500 narrative words.
rules.ui_message: When no external length exists, Standard mode targets 5,500 narrative words.

rules.requirement: Recommend Compact/Standard/Comprehensive primarily from complexity, not funding amount.
rules.ui_message: The proposal size fits the project's complexity

rules.requirement: External word/page/character limits override PaperAid funding modes.
rules.ui_message: The call's own limits replace PaperAid's lengths

rules.requirement: Field-limited applications must be represented as per-field constraints.
rules.ui_message: Each form box has its own limit

rules.requirement: Each form field must comply with its own hard limit.
rules.ui_message: Every form box is within its limit

rules.requirement: Published scoring criteria should influence section depth and emphasis.
rules.ui_message: The scoring criteria shape the plan's depth

rules.requirement: Proposal must articulate a clear problem/need/opportunity grounded in evidence.
rules.ui_message: The problem is clear and grounded in evidence

rules.requirement: Problem analysis should identify material root causes, not only symptoms.
rules.ui_message: Root causes are analysed, not only symptoms

rules.requirement: Problem analysis should identify affected population and geography.
rules.ui_message: The affected population and geography are identified

rules.requirement: Material quantitative claims should be supported by appropriate evidence.
rules.ui_message: Quantitative claims are supported by evidence

rules.requirement: Every non-trivial funding proposal must have a Results Model.
rules.ui_message: The proposal has a complete Results Model

rules.requirement: Goal must describe higher-level intended change, not activities.
rules.ui_message: The goal is a higher-level change, not an activity

rules.requirement: Objectives must respond directly to the problem/project logic.
rules.ui_message: The objectives answer the problem

rules.requirement: Objectives should be sufficiently specific and assessable for the donor context.
rules.ui_message: The objectives are specific and assessable

rules.requirement: Every activity in the Results Model maps to an output.
rules.ui_message: Every activity leads to an output

rules.requirement: Every output maps to at least one outcome.
rules.ui_message: Every output leads to an outcome

rules.requirement: Outputs describe products/services/deliverables rather than activities disguised as results.
rules.ui_message: Outputs are deliverables, not activities

rules.requirement: Outcomes describe plausible change rather than completed activities.
rules.ui_message: Outcomes describe change, not completed activities

rules.requirement: Every outcome has at least one indicator in Standard/Comprehensive proposals.
rules.ui_message: Every outcome has an indicator

rules.requirement: Outputs have indicators when required by donor/results framework.
rules.ui_message: Every output has an indicator

rules.requirement: Each indicator measures the result level under which it sits.
rules.ui_message: Each indicator measures its own result level

rules.requirement: Each active indicator has a defined unit.
rules.ui_message: Each indicator has a unit

rules.requirement: Each outcome indicator has a baseline or stated baseline-establishment plan/date.
rules.ui_message: Each outcome indicator has a baseline or a plan to set one

rules.requirement: Each outcome indicator has a target unless donor rules explicitly allow otherwise.
rules.ui_message: Each outcome indicator has a target

rules.requirement: Indicator targets should be plausible relative to baseline, duration, resources, and scale.
rules.ui_message: Targets are plausible for the baseline, time and resources

rules.requirement: Indicators include meaningful disaggregation when required/relevant.
rules.ui_message: Indicators are disaggregated where required

rules.requirement: Each indicator identifies a means of verification/data source.
rules.ui_message: Each indicator has a means of verification

rules.requirement: Each indicator identifies measurement frequency where applicable.
rules.ui_message: Each indicator has a measurement frequency

rules.requirement: Each indicator identifies a responsible role/unit.
rules.ui_message: Each indicator has a responsible role

rules.requirement: Technical approach explains why the intervention is expected to address the problem.
rules.ui_message: The approach explains why it will address the problem

rules.requirement: Technical approach uses effectiveness/rationale evidence where appropriate.
rules.ui_message: The approach uses evidence of what works

rules.requirement: Distinguish what is novel/adapted from standard practice when relevant.
rules.ui_message: What is new or adapted is distinguished from standard practice

rules.requirement: Every major activity appears in the implementation timeline.
rules.ui_message: Every major activity is in the timeline

rules.requirement: Every costed activity maps to at least one budget line.
rules.ui_message: Every costed activity has a budget line

rules.requirement: Every budget line maps to an activity or declared support/administrative category.
rules.ui_message: Every budget line belongs to an activity or a declared support cost

rules.requirement: Budget unit cost × quantity equals line subtotal.
rules.ui_message: Every budget line's total is its quantity times its unit cost

rules.requirement: Budget category totals reconcile to the grand total.
rules.ui_message: Category totals add up to the grand total

rules.requirement: Requested amount does not exceed funding ceiling.
rules.ui_message: The amount requested is within the funding ceiling

rules.requirement: Required cost share/co-financing meets required percentage and calculation base.
rules.ui_message: The required cost share is met

rules.requirement: Indirect costs use the rate and base allowed by the governing call/policy.
rules.ui_message: Indirect costs follow the allowed rate and base

rules.requirement: Prohibited costs identified by the call do not appear in the budget.
rules.ui_message: No cost the call prohibits is in the budget

rules.requirement: Multi-year and category subtotals reconcile to the same grand total.
rules.ui_message: Year and category totals give the same grand total

rules.requirement: Currency conversion stores exchange rate and date when conversion affects values.
rules.ui_message: Currency conversions state their rate and date

rules.requirement: Staff effort/LOE is consistent across narrative, timeline, and budget.
rules.ui_message: Staff time agrees across the narrative, workplan and budget

rules.requirement: Beneficiary counts, duration, totals, and major numeric commitments are consistent across sections/annexes.
rules.ui_message: Figures agree across the narrative, tables and budget

rules.requirement: MEL narrative explains how performance/outcomes will be measured and used.
rules.ui_message: The MEL plan says how results will be measured and used

rules.requirement: Substantial MEL plans identify data-quality assurance mechanisms.

rules.requirement: MEL includes learning/adaptation when implementation learning is relevant.

rules.requirement: Evaluation timing/independence is described when evaluation is required/material.
rules.ui_message: Evaluation timing and independence are described

rules.requirement: Projects collecting personal/sensitive data include appropriate data-protection arrangements.
rules.ui_message: Personal data is protected

rules.requirement: Substantial MEL framework with no identifiable resources is flagged.
